newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end higher despite mixed sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end higher despite mixed sentiment.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended higher on Monday despite mixed sentiment due to continued fresh buying in some blue chip counters and small stocks, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index closed 2.12 points, or 0.32 percent, higher at 675.81 points.
However, decliners led advancers by 63 to 60, with 64 counters unchanged. Total turn-over was estimated at about 620 billion rupiah against 524.7 billion on Friday.
"Today is like a trial period for the future. Look at the volume .. it is increasing gradually," an analyst with a local firm said.

He said there was no pressure on sentiment either from politics or macroeconomic fundamentals although some concerns remain ahead of the May 29 general elections. "After 16 days of campaigning, everything seems under control. Maybe it triggered foreign buyers to re-collect stocks," he said.
But the broker added market sentiment would remain volatile until the campaign and the election were completed.
Blue chip counters such as Indosat, Bank Negara Indonesia, cigarette maker Sampoerna and cement firm Semen Gresik were among the targets of foreign buyers, brokers said.
